metadata.description: A single-plugin marketplace for the encrypted-backup skill — real, encrypted 3-2-1 disaster-recovery backups for sensitive personal directories, with no plaintext ever leaving the machine.

plugins.name: encrypted-backup
plugins.description: Set up, run, check, and restore an encrypted 3-2-1 backup for sensitive local directories — local git history plus an encrypted restic repo mirrored to a second drive and an offsite cloud remote (Google Drive, OneDrive, Proton Drive, or any rclone backend). Linux, macOS, and Windows. By design, writes outside its own plugin directory — the user-chosen folder being backed up, ~/Backups, and ~/.config/claude-encrypted-backup — see the README's "What this touches on your machine" section for the exact list.
